verdict.rationale: Jeeves is a fintech/financial-operations platform that ships its own MCP server so external AI agents can call ITS tools (jeeves-docs-13/33, jeeves-probe-3); there is no evidence of Jeeves itself acting as an MCP client that plugs in and consumes other parties' MCP servers. Given Jeeves's product role is a financial back-office SaaS exposing tools (not an AI agent/assistant consuming external tool servers), this client-side axis is a category mismatch for the evidence and product role presented.
